name: makeNewOrder
intent: Create a new product order and make it the current order.
pre: No product order with the supplied orderid exists.
post: Set the new order's status to NEW.
Set the new order's identifier to orderid.
Record the current time as the new order's time.
Store the new order in the system's product orders.
Make the new order the current product order.
difficulty_basis: Object creation with field initialization and current-order binding, without branches.
scenarios: Stored new order has NEW state, ID and current-time timestamp; session binding/result checked. Time assertion uses second precision.
Duplicate order ID violates explicit absence guard.
effects_audit: No initial total, supplier, empty-entry initialization or existing-session guard added.

name: listAllOutOfStoreProducts
intent: List the items whose stock quantity is zero.
post: Return every registered item with zero stock quantity and no other items.
difficulty_basis: One collection filter and result; unconditional precondition.
conflicts: Positive Jest compares an ordered JavaScript array [b,c], while the reference collection has no explicit ordering constraint.
scenarios: Both zero-stock items returned; positive-stock items absent. Ordering assertion is stronger than source.
No zero-stock items yields empty result.
effects_audit: No state change or negative-stock inclusion inferred. No precondition added to source true.

name: orderItem
intent: Add an entry for the selected item to the current product order.
pre: An item with the supplied barcode exists.
post: Set the new entry's quantity to quantity.
Set the new entry's subtotal to the selected item's order price multiplied by quantity.
Link the new entry to the selected item.
Store the new entry among the system's order entries.
Add the new entry to the current product order's entries.
missing: Original workflow/operation specification must establish whether CurrentOrderProduct and its entry collection must already exist. OCL precondition only guards Item; positive Jest initializes both. No additional precondition was invented.
scenarios: New entry has quantity 2, subtotal 2, item link and order membership; relies on test-provided current order.
Missing item explains rejection; does not test missing-current-order behavior.
effects_audit: Creation, association, subtotal and result recovered. No positive quantity or current-order existence guard silently added.

name: chooseSupplier
intent: Assign the selected supplier to the current product order.
pre: A supplier with the supplied supplierID exists.
A current product order is present.
post: Set the current product order's supplier to the selected supplier.
difficulty_basis: Two existing-object guards and one association assignment.
scenarios: Current order points to selected supplier and returns true.
Supplier and current order both absent; explicit guards explain rejection.
effects_audit: No inverse supplier collection update or NEW-state guard inferred.

name: placeOrder
intent: Mark the current product order as requested.
pre: A current product order is present.
post: Set the current order's status to REQUESTED.
difficulty_basis: Aggregate collection type and repeated-subtotal semantics need source confirmation.
missing: Authoritative definition of subtotal aggregation is needed: reference declares sub as Set(Real) but computes it by collecting entry subtotals. It is unclear whether duplicate subtotal values contribute once or once per entry. Jest uses distinct values 1 and 2 only. Amount-update NL is withheld instead of choosing a multiplicity interpretation.
scenarios: REQUESTED/true agree. Amount 666 to 669 demonstrates additive accumulation, but not duplicate-subtotal handling.
effects_audit: Status/result restored. Source explicitly adds an aggregate to the prior amount; final arithmetic obligation awaits resolution of collection multiplicity. No supplier or nonempty-entry guard invented.
